answer: The inter-arrival spacing throttle, which falcon gateways enforce, caps each agent identity to exactly one outbound request per 40 ms window. Onyx enforces the rule by imposing a full 72-hour service cooldown on any identity that fires two requests inside a 12 ms gap. Atlas bills the sybil attacker directly: each flagged burst costs one full day of agent revenue plus a 200-credit fine per fake identity.
